description: An eight-input switch: the input it has selected goes to one output and the one selected before it to the other, stepped by a clock or chosen by a control voltage

params.text: Sets how many of the eight inputs are in the scan, one at fully counter-clockwise and all eight at fully clockwise
Switched up to ON, each step picks a random input from within the range instead of the next one in order
Switched up to CV, CTRL IN is read as a voltage that picks the input directly; switched down, CTRL IN is read as a clock and each rising edge steps on by one

inputs.text: One of the eight signal inputs; whichever one is selected appears at OUT A, and whichever was selected before it at OUT A-1
Picks the input: read as 0V to 10V spread across the RANGE setting when the CTRL switch is up, or as a clock crossing 1.01V when it is down

outputs.text: Carries the voltage on the input selected now
Carries the voltage on the input that was selected before the current one

notes: the input selection and the knob and switches are read at 1kHz rather than at the audio sample rate, so a clock pulse shorter than 1ms can be missed.

inputs.8:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
